How to watch Sporting CP vs Arsenal on different devicesWatching the match depends on two things: whether your streaming service supports your device and whether your VPN works on that device if the stream is geo-restricted. Some platforms, such as Roku and certain Samsung TVs, do not support VPN apps directly, so you may need a workaround like a browser, mobile device, casting, or an HDMI connection. Web browsers usually provide the simplest setup, and mobile devices on iOS and Android are also easy because both streaming and VPN apps are widely supported. Smart TVs and streaming devices vary more: Fire TV, Android TV, Google TV, and newer Apple TV setups are usually the most flexible, while some Samsung and LG TVs may support the streaming service but not a native VPN app. Game consoles can stream through supported apps or browsers, but VPN support is generally indirect. The easiest option is watching on a laptop or mobile browser with a VPN active. For TVs without VPN app support, using an HDMI cable or casting from your phone may be necessary. Fire TV and Android TV usually offer the smoothest setup because both the VPN and streaming app are more likely to work directly on the device.
